interpretive_contract: Camera, narration, captions and seconds are editorial decisions. Every shot must refer to a beat in presentations.json; no shot changes the source-scoped concepts or relations.
time_semantics: Suggested shot durations measure presentation time only; they do not represent actual timings of cosmic influences.

treatments.title: From the planetary world toward Earth

shots.framing: Wide view: all three named regions persist, with attention on the planetary source; no process arrow is displayed yet.
shots.caption: Begin with the planetary world.
shots.narration: In Gurdjieff’s account, recorded by Ouspensky, the planetary world is the source of influences described as reaching organic life.
shots.nonclaim: This is not a map of astronomical distances or a ray of literal energy.

shots.framing: Keep the same regions. Bring into focus recognizable living subjects and a dashed reception indication that terminates at life.
shots.caption: Organic life receives the planetary influences.
shots.narration: The account assigns the act of reception to terrestrial organic life—not simply to undifferentiated ground.
shots.nonclaim: Dashed marks identify a relationship; their shape and pacing do not describe particles or biological uptake.

shots.framing: Keep reception visible and reveal a distinct solid relationship from organic life toward Earth. Preserve all anchors.
shots.caption: Organic life mediates their relation to Earth.
shots.narration: Within this teaching, organic life is an intermediary that makes the planetary influences receivable by Earth.
shots.nonclaim: No physical conversion rate or conserved material stream is specified.

treatments.title: From Earth's dependency back to the source

shots.framing: Begin at the terrestrial recipient while leaving the other two named regions perceptibly present.
shots.caption: Start with Earth—the recipient.
shots.narration: Begin with Earth, whose role we are examining inside the reported cosmological account.
shots.nonclaim: Starting here is an explanatory choice, not a claim that Earth existed or acted first.

shots.framing: Reveal a continuous solid mediation relationship from living subjects to Earth; do not animate a physical response occurring before a cause.
shots.caption: Earth's relation involves a living intermediary.
shots.narration: The account describes terrestrial organic life as an intermediary. This is a structural disclosure, not a time-lapse.
shots.nonclaim: The mediation relationship is not an empirically measured material conduit.

shots.framing: Reveal the dashed reception relation from the planetary region to organic life while retaining the separate solid mediation relationship.
shots.caption: The planetary world supplies what life receives.
shots.narration: We can now trace the complete source-scoped structure: planetary influences are received by organic life, which mediates them toward Earth.
shots.nonclaim: The reverse order of discovery does not reverse the direction of the claimed relations.
